events.title: US-Japan-Korea Coordinated Currency Intervention
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention (July 31-August 1). South Korea joined unprecedented joint FX intervention. Won hit 9-month high. First joint US-Japan FX intervention in years.

events.title: Hormuz Deal Framework — 60-Day Interim Agreement Imminent
events.summary: Iran-Oman-US nearing 60-day interim agreement to reopen Strait of Hormuz. Trump says deal could come 'today or tomorrow'. Strait still physically disrupted. Oil crashed 13.4% to $75.69.

events.title: KOSDAQ/KOSPI Consecutive Circuit Breakers — AI Bubble Implosion
events.summary: KOSPI and KOSDAQ triggered back-to-back circuit breakers on July 29 — first-ever consecutive activation. KOSDAQ fell 8.05%. Semiconductor stocks plummeted. AI bubble bursting.

events.title: Argentina-China Currency Swap Renewed — $18-20B, 5-Year Term
events.summary: Argentina renewed China currency swap to 5-year term, locking in $18-20B reserves. Previous swap expired August 6. Crisis averted.

events.title: Russia Latent Banking Crisis — NPLs >10%, Deposit Outflows $25B YTD
events.summary: Russia's banking system showing systemic stress. NPLs >10%. Deposit outflows $25B YTD. Sberbank warns. Kremlin think tank warns systemic crisis possible by October 2026.

events.title: Ebola Outbreak (Bundibugyo Strain) — WHO PHEIC, Fastest-Growing on Record
events.summary: WHO declared PHEIC May 17. Bundibugyo strain — no vaccine. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. DRC + Uganda.
